subject: Operational evidence request for DPIA: Art.28/30 extracts, KMS logs, and subprocessors
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <security@primed.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: operational evidence for DPIA — Art.28/30 extracts and KMS logs

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As part of our DPIA and procurement checklist for the upcoming contract, our privacy team has two follow-up asks so we can close our internal review:

1) A copy (or excerpt) of your Art.30 processing record that shows processing activities for the text-generation/chat endpoints used by our account (scoped to EU-region deployments).
2) KMS access logs and a short explanation of key custody/rotation practices for the keys that protect customer data in transit/at-rest (sample window: last 30 days).
3) Current subprocessor inventory (names + countries + purpose) and confirmation of where SCCs/BCRs are applied for transfers.
4) Short timeline for retention of request-level logs and an excerpt of your processing ledger that shows categories retained for audit purposes.

If you can provide these as downloadable artifacts (PDF/CSV/log excerpt) that would be ideal. We typically need this evidence to complete the DPIA within 10 business days; can you confirm an estimated delivery (we'd appreciate anything in 5-7 business days if possible)?

Also please flag any items that are sensitive and require a secure upload channel or an NDA addendum.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Data Protection Officer | PriMed Health
security@primed.com

--
PriMed Health is a healthcare provider in the EU. This message may contain confidential information.

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Ortiz <security@primed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T13:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: operational evidence for DPIA — Art.28/30 extracts and KMS logs

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. We can produce the artifacts you requested. High-level plan below and attachments we will begin assembling:

- Art.30: we will extract a scoped snapshot covering the chat/text-gen endpoints operating in the eu-west-1 region and include processing purposes and categories (attachment: redwood_art30_snapshot_20260719.pdf).
- Subprocessor inventory: current export (attachment: subprocessor_inventory_20260719.csv).
- KMS: we'll provide a redacted access log excerpt for the past 30 days and a one-page summary of key custody/rotation practices. Note that some key identifiers are redacted for security — we'll provide hashed IDs and a validation checklist.
- Processing ledger / retention: we'll include an export and short notes on retention windows and anonymisation/purge flows (attachment: processing_ledger_excerpt.csv).

Internal ask: Laura — can you run the KMS log extract and produce kms_access_excerpt.log and the one-page custody note? Marissa — can you prepare the Art.30 snapshot with the EU-scope and confirm SCC usage for any transfers to non-EEA subprocessors?

Elena, we anticipate having the initial package ready by 2026-07-22 (3 business days). If you need the KMS extract earlier we can prioritize and aim for 2026-07-21. Please confirm the preferred delivery channel — we support secure drive links, SFTP, or our customer evidence portal.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Trust & Privacy | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0147

Attachments: redwood_art30_snapshot_20260719.pdf, subprocessor_inventory_20260719.csv

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T14:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: operational evidence for DPIA — Art.28/30 extracts and KMS logs

Received. Quick ops plan:

- KMS log extract (kms_access_excerpt.log): I'll pull audit logs for the last 30 days from the key-management cluster in eu-west-1. Will redact key material and any internal operator identifiers; will include an index mapping for hashes. ETA: 2026-07-21 11:00Z.
- Art.30 snapshot (redwood_art30_snapshot_20260719.pdf): Marissa + I will confirm scope to only include PriMed-relevant endpoints and data categories. Will add processing lawful basis and subprocessors engaged for each activity. ETA: 2026-07-22 EOD.
- Subprocessor SCCs: Marissa to check contract notes and flag any non-EEA subprocessors and applicable SCCs/BCRs — will add a short explanatory paragraph.
- Processing ledger excerpt (processing_ledger_excerpt.csv): I'll generate a CSV showing categories, retention windows and last purge dates for the dataset families used by PriMed. ETA: 2026-07-21 EOD.

Marissa — can you confirm SCC status for CloudPartner X and ArchiveVault (I believe ArchiveVault is UK-based with SCCs executed)? Also confirm whether the subprocessor inventory export includes country codes (if not, add them).

I'll prepare the secure upload link for PriMed and include a short readme describing redactions.

Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Engineering | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments planned: kms_access_excerpt.log, processing_ledger_excerpt.csv

Hi Rishi / Redwood team,

Thanks — that timeline sounds great and 2026-07-22 will work for our DPIA completion if the artifacts arrive by end of day. A couple of small clarifications:

- For the KMS logs, we only need activity that shows customer-key usage (policy attach/detach, encrypt/decrypt events) and the list of principals that had access in the window. Redaction is fine for operator names.
- For Art.30, please include the named subprocessors and the legal basis line for each processing activity.

We prefer a secure Drive folder for uploads. Please use the secure upload placeholder in the Drive link below and set viewer/download permissions to PriMed Health only.

Upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPRIMED_UPLOAD_PLACEHOLDER

If anything changes on timing, please let us know immediately so we can extend the DPIA internal deadline.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Data Protection Officer | PriMed Health
